title: fix(metadata)!: the boot priming pass primes every holder of a name two packages hold, of a type stored per (package, name), so a bare read of that name is refused after the pass as without it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuS8SPP6sDywXCiLYGv5CHC7)_
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgT7PFLjd2CJuCsgC4T (card thread; taken over from domain:server#5 · os-bill, takeover claim 6823813460)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：接了数据库加载器的宿主，启动预载对按包存放的九类（`api`、`agent`、`skill`、`action`、`permission`、`flow`、`picklist`、`mapping`、`dataset`），只要一个名字有两个以上的包持有，就把每个包的那一项都载进注册表；只有一个包持有的名字照旧只载一项。两包同名旁边的无包行不盖宿主包戳，留在裸槽。
- 为什么改：两个包同名时，启动后不带包名的读取答了最后存的那个包的正文，没有报歧义（专题 #31527 红线 2）；只按列绑定的行，列表里还少了另一个包。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING）：启动后裸读两包同名项、以及没有合并清单时 runtime 的裸 `/actions` 调用，原来拿到其中一个包的，现在 409 并点名两个包；都和不预载时一样。flow 再收窄两处：ObjectQL 启动同步登记两个包的同名 flow 后，不带包名的 resolver 从答最后存的那个改为 409 点名两包；automation 引擎原来把最后存的那个装在裸名下、裸调用就跑它，现在裸调用 409 点名两包：有 protocol 服务时（ObjectQLPlugin 默认就有）两个包的 flow 各装在自己的槽里，没有 protocol 服务时两个都不装并 warn、原来能派发的 flow 不再派发。两包旁边再有无包行时，环境自己那条 flow 两种组合下都不再装上（dogfood pin 先红后绿）。action 有一格 CONTROL 在 main 上被 #32719 带出三方 409，属 #32791 的回归，本 PR 只宽断言并注明。冷启动封印只在两包命名空间相遇时 warn，命名空间不同就不 warn，但 resolver 照样拒绝。单持有者答案全部不动。仓库里没有组合接数据库加载器，第一方调用方 0，库里的行不增不改。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `unscopedTypeRows`（改用 main 的 `pluralEntryKeys` 按（包, 名）分行），`metadata-manager.ts` 的 `withLoaderEntryPackages`（两包同名时按内容配对盖包戳），`plugin.ts` 的 `contestedNames` / `primingOrder`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t '#32521'`，应见 103 passed；flow 两处收窄：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/flow-two-holders-stored-rows.dogfood.test.ts`，应见 10 passed（先 `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`，dogfood 读的是 dist）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32521

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a host that wires a `DatabaseLoader` (none in the workspace), after the boot priming pass a read naming no package (`MetadataManager.get`, `getDiagnosed`) of an `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `permission`, `flow`, `picklist`, `mapping` or `dataset` whose name two packages' stored rows hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where it served the body of the row saved last; the same read without the pass already refused. Beside a package-less row of that name saved last, a read naming a package that holds none of its rows answers nothing, as without the pass, where it served that row (row 7a). The runtime's bare `/actions` door with no merged listing is refused the same way (row 8). For `flow`, two readers past objectql's start-up sync narrow too: objectql's package-scoped resolver refuses the bare name naming both, where it resolved the row saved last (row 11a), and the automation engine, which armed that row's flow under the bare name and ran it for a bare call, refuses a bare call naming both: with the `protocol` service (`ObjectQLPlugin`'s default) it arms each package's flow in that package's slot (row 11b-ii), and with none it arms neither, with a warning (row 11b-i). Beside a package-less row of the name, the environment's own flow, which was armed, is armed in neither composition (rows 11a, 11b, 11e). Every other moved answer hands on, registers or warns about more holders and refuses nothing. No answer for a name one package holds moves.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated — `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx` (`loadManyKeyed`): its type list now names the ten by-package types of this release, and its stamp paragraph says a name two or more packages hold is handed on once per holder, each body stamped with its own row's package. No skill teaches how many holders `loadMany` hands on or what a bare read answers after a boot over a `DatabaseLoader`.

`Metadata-protocol: none` because no key, value, requirement or type a metadata author writes moves; only what the loaders hand on and the boot registers does (the #29029 and #32458 precedent).

**Narrowing: yes**, five faces (rows 1, 7a, 8, 11a and 11b; 11b-ii also widens: the other package's flow is armed in its own slot). First-party callers: **0**. `MetadataManager` wires a `DatabaseLoader` only through `config.driver` (with `config.datasource`), `setDatabaseDriver` or `setDataEngine`, and no package, app or example calls them; `MetadataPlugin` builds its manager with neither.

## The merge round (head `2126b08c` → `131bbc55`)

`origin/main` merged at `1ed281f6` (merge, never rebased), after #32569 and #32687 (#32517) landed. Four files conflicted, all in `packages/metadata`:

- `package-slotted-store.ts`: main's version taken whole. This PR's `pluralEntryKey` and `namesSeveralPackagesHold` are deleted; #32517's `pluralEntryKeys` (one entry per `(package, name)`, a package-less entry under a one-holder name taking that holder's key) is the one key every plural read now uses. The PR adds no export any more.
- `metadata-manager.ts`: main's `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` / `loadManyKeyedSlotted` taken whole (#32517 already keys them per `(package, name)` across loaders, which was this PR's row 6). This PR keeps only its `withLoaderEntryPackages` content pairing (row 6a), re-applied unchanged.
- `database-loader.ts`: `unscopedTypeRows` keys an unbundled by-package type's rows through `pluralEntryKeys`, FROM this PR's own contested-name rule. One deliberate difference from `2126b08c`: an action one package binds to two objects is one row per `(package, name)` here (the binding saved last), as #32517 declares for every plural read, where `2126b08c` kept one per binding for a contested name only.
- `plugin.ts` (auto-merged, then edited): `contestedNames` now reads `pluralEntryKeys` (a name whose entries carry two or more keys is a name two or more packages hold) instead of the deleted helper.
- `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: both sides edited the unbundled plural-read pin; the merged pin asserts both halves — the door's store per #32517 and the stored rows per this PR.

The type set: `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` on main now carries `flow` (#31696), `picklist`, `mapping` and `dataset` (#31700) beside the five of `2126b08c`. Every pin of this PR takes the unbundled types from that live set, so all nine are pinned, and the changeset, this body and the doc page now name nine (the old "five types" and row 11 were false). `flow` was re-measured separately: row 11 below.

## Why

On a host that wires a `DatabaseLoader`, the boot priming pass registered one item per name for these types, so after the boot a read naming no package of a name two packages hold answered the body of the row saved last instead of the `409` naming both that the same read answers without the pass (epic #31527 red line 2), and `list` dropped every holder but one. The epic seat's rulings bound the fix: every holder of such a name is kept and primed, and no answer for a name one package holds moves (red line 3).

The epic seat's ruling, verbatim: "when two holders exist, a bare read answers 409 again after the boot preload, the same as without the preload (red line 2). The loadMany/loadManyKeyed answer change gets its own FROM → TO and a pin, plus a contract review. Unfiltered list reads keep every holder."

## Red-line round (head `131bbc55` → `4cc152e4`)

Epic red-line read 6829411450 (NO PASS: B1, B2) and contract review 6829441453 (PASS, S1 = B1, N3). Three commits, no merge, no rebase; no source line of any package moves except one jsdoc paragraph in `packages/metadata`: `14fed1e5` (B1/B2/S1/N3), `25d7cd62`, which adopts the test patch posted on this PR in comment 6829667339 (measured there on `131bbc55`; its gaps are this round's B1 and B2), and `4cc152e4` (that pin's fake `findOne` through the predicate gate).

- **B1 / S1.** The flow change narrows at two readers past objectql's sync, now declared as rows 11a and 11b and pinned by the new `flow-two-holders-stored-rows.dogfood.test.ts` (red over main's source, green here; see Tests). The four untrue sentences are corrected: the `Clause-②:` line here and in the changeset (they no longer say every other moved answer refuses nothing), row 11's arm (split into 11, 11a, 11b, 11c), and the changeset's BREAKING paragraph (one kind of host, three faces, not "one caller"). Row 11 and the changeset now say the seal warns only where the two holders' namespaces meet, while the resolver refuses either way.
- **B2.** The legacy bare `SchemaRegistry.getItem('flow', name)` move is declared (row 11c) with the sweep below: no production reader reaches it with two holders, so nothing is refused there.
- **Comment 6829667339 adopted whole.** Its `packages/objectql/src/metadata-sync-flow-two-holders.test.ts` is committed as posted plus two changes: one comment on the bare-lookup assertion (it is row 11c's declared move, not an endorsed answer), and its fake `findOne` now opens with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate` (`check:engine-double-contract` refused it otherwise; the pinned ledger learns the file); it pins row 11 (both slots filled, the seal warns once), row 11c, and the two registry rows its measurements add (11d, 11e). Its changeset wording is taken into the flow bullet. No conflict with B1/B2: its pin stops at the registry and the seal, and the dogfood pin carries the two narrowing readers past them; its note that the bare lookup's pick "may be a follow-up card" agrees with B2's sweep (no production reader, so nothing is refused there in this PR).
- **N3.** `unscopedTypeRows`' first jsdoc paragraph no longer says a by-package type answers one row per name.
- Red-line nits, to follow-up cards, not this round: a pin for a contested action name one holder binds to two objects; the seal across two installed namespaces, measured; the `yes (narrowing)` spelling is the seat's call (this PR keeps `no (narrowing)`, as #32687 and #32458).

### B2 sweep: who calls `SchemaRegistry.getItem` with no package

Static, at this head:

```sh
grep -rnE "\.getItem\(" packages --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx \
  | grep -vE "test|node_modules|dist/|\.d\.ts|localStorage|sessionStorage|storage\.getItem"   # 28 lines, 17 files
grep -rnE "[^.a-zA-Z]getItem\(|this\.getItem\(" packages/objectql/src packages/services/service-automation/src \
  packages/runtime/src packages/rest/src --include=*.ts | grep -vE "test|\.d\.ts"            # prints comment lines only: the definition (registry.ts:8669) and :8955 spell the call with a type argument
grep -rnE "\.getItem(\?\.)?(<[^>]*>)?\(|\?\.getItem\(" packages --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx \
  | grep -vE "test|node_modules|dist/|\.d\.ts|storage\.getItem" | grep -vE "\.getItem\("   # the optional-call and type-argument spellings the first grep misses
```

Of the 28 lines, 12 are comments, doc strings or the client SDK (`client.meta.getItem`, an HTTP read, not the registry), and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:2303` is the metadata service's own `getItem`. The registry callers:

| Caller | Reaches a bare `flow` read with two holders? |
|:--|:--|
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:970` (bare `/meta/:type/:name`) | No: a no-package read of a package-scoped type is answered first by `packagelessScopedRead` (`:466`, `:965`): `registry.resolveItem(type, name, null)`, the package-scoped resolution, which refuses a name two packages hold. |
| `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts:277` (layered read's code half) | No: the door asks `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` first, and in process the code half reads the metadata service first, whose bare read of the name throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409`); `rethrowPackageScopedRefusal` rethrows it for every type but a one-live-holder `action`. |
| `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts:1126` (`readCodeLayerForCarryForward`) | No: it reads the metadata service first with no `try`, so the same `409` fails the save before the registry line. |
| `protocol-registry-hydration.ts:623` (stored flow row hydration) | Not a reader: its answer is only compared (`incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot`) to decide whether an incoming stored row takes the bare slot, and it changes the outcome only when the held item is a stored declared-override row; no caller is served it. Unchanged by this PR (two packages shipping one flow name already reach it on main); left to a follow-up card with N1/N2. |
| `protocol-write-gates.ts:703` | Names the base package. |
| `protocol-save.ts:1314`, `protocol-authoring-gate.ts:196`, `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:226`, `core/src/security/security-catalog.ts:504`, `objectql/src/registry.ts:8955` | Other types only (`view`; `position`, `object`, `permission`; `action`; the security catalog's types; types not addressed by package). |
| `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts:82` | Only for a registry with no `getArtifactItem` (partial test doubles); the real `SchemaRegistry` takes `getArtifactItem`. |

The spellings the first grep missed (contract review N4) read other types: `objectql/src/plugin.ts:4367` and `runtime/src/action-execution.ts:5952` (`action`), `plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts:114` and `:213` (`permission`, `position`), `service-print/src/print-service.ts:380` (`page`, a nested type argument the third grep's pattern also misses), and `objectql/src/registry.ts:8955` (types not addressed by package). None reads `flow`.

No service-automation code calls `getItem` for a flow: the boot pull reads `listItems('flow')`, and a bare name resolves through `flowNameResolver` (row 11a).

Measured: three dogfood files that boot real stacks where two packages ship one flow name (`flow-name-per-namespace`, `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`, `approval-flow-name-per-namespace`), run once with `SchemaRegistry.prototype.getItem` wrapped to record every no-package `flow` call while two packages hold the name (uncommitted copies, deleted): 20 tests passed; no-package `flow` calls 0, two-holder hits 0, in all three.

## Second delta round (head `4cc152e4` → `d50adfbf`)

Contract review r2 6832698813 (FAIL: B3, B4, S2, N4, N6, N7, 11f) and the epic seat's ruling on it. Two commits, merge only, no rebase: `b0ed5664` merges `origin/main` at `ee230a25` (no conflict), `d50adfbf` carries this round. No source line of any package moves but one jsdoc paragraph (N7).

- **CI red on `4cc152e4` (Test Core 1/8, `database-loader.test.ts`, the action C3 CONTROL with host `com.host.app`).** Not a flake and not this PR's code: 40 loops of that file on `4cc152e4` alone were green, and the cell turns red only once main is merged, because main's `070e87964` (#32719) makes a bare action read judge the loaders' slots beside the registry's. **B4, per the epic seat's ruling:** the cell is not pinned three-way; it asserts only a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` whose candidates include `com.alpha.app` and the environment, and its comment and row C3 say: 多出的 com.host.app 是 #32791 的回归，在那里修；修好后再收紧这一格. Re-measured on the merged tree: the action C3 cells, rows 1, 7, 7a and 8 — `database-loader.test.ts` + `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` 829 passed (829), `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` 47 passed (47).
- **B3.** "Arms neither" was true only with no `protocol` service. Row 11b is split by composition: 11b-i (no `protocol`: neither armed, warns) and 11b-ii (`ObjectQLPlugin`'s default `protocol` service: each package's flow armed in its own slot, no warning, the bare `getFlow` / `execute` / `toggleFlow` refused naming both). FROM in both is the row saved last (beta) armed under the bare name. Corrected in the `Clause-②:` line, the Narrowing line, the 速读 risk line, the changeset's BREAKING paragraph and its boot-pull bullet. New pin ③ in the dogfood file: the real `ObjectQLPlugin` in its default mode on a `LiteKernel`, the manager as the `metadata` service, the real automation plugin, both store read orders. Red over main's source, green here (Tests).
- **S2.** Two holders beside a package-less row: the resolver refuses naming both, and the environment's own flow, armed on main, is armed in neither composition (rows 11a, 11b-i', 11b-ii', 11e; changeset). Pinned in both orders (the package-less row saved first or last) through the resolver and both compositions.
- **N4.** The B2 sweep counts are corrected (17 files, 12 comment lines); a third grep catches the optional-call and type-argument spellings, and the sites it adds are listed (none reads `flow`). The changeset's "every other caller" now names the stored-row hydration comparator.
- **N6.** Tighter asserts: 11a asserts the refusal's reason; 11b-i asserts exactly one "failed to register flow" line naming both; 11e counts the seal's warnings (one).
- **N7.** The changeset says five faces, not three; `unscopedTypeRows`' jsdoc says a bundled type's keys are in the paragraphs below.
- **11f.** The bare `getArtifactItem('flow', name)` is declared: a first-composite pick, main's, not changed here.

### After both flows are armed: does any reader silently use one of them?

The epic seat's question: on a default `ObjectQLPlugin` host both packages' flows are armed. No serving reader picks one. Measured on that host, two holders, and again beside a package-less row saved last (an uncommitted probe on the dogfood file's `realHost`, deleted):

| Reader | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| `engine.getFlow(name)`, `engine.execute(name, {})`, `engine.toggleFlow(name, false)` | refused, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming both packages (pinned in ③ and S2) |
| `engine.flowDispatchHolder(name)` (what the record-trigger and schedule dispatchers ask) | `{ packageId: null, claimBare: false }`: no package is claimed for the bare name |
| the engine's own `flows.get(name)` (the run, resume, subflow-guard and definition reads) | nothing: a name two slots hold files each flow under its slot key, so the bare key misses instead of picking |
| `engine.getFlowSlot(pkg, name)` | each package's own flow (`alpha`, `beta`); `null` for no package |
| registry `getItem('flow', name)` (11c) | `alpha`, the first registered (the package-less flow beside a package-less row, 11e) |
| registry `getArtifactItem('flow', name)` (11f) | `alpha` in both shapes |

So the only reads that still answer one of the two are the registry's legacy bare `getItem` (11c) and `getArtifactItem` (11f). Inside the engine every bare reader goes through `resolveFlowKey` / `bareFlowKey`, which refuse a name two slots hold. Of the registry reads, the B2 sweep finds no production reader that serves `getItem` with two holders. `getArtifactItem` serves no reader either: the stored-row hydration only compares its answer, and the precedence's one-owner path refuses first. Both are declared silent picks, not changed here; a follow-up card is the seat's call.

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

FROM is `origin/main` at `34890e0e` (#32458, #32569 and #32687 landed); rows 1, 7, 7a, 8, 11a, 11b and C3 re-measured over main's tip `ee230a25` in the second delta round (FROM unchanged but for C3's one action cell). TO is this head. First-party count 0 on every row: only a host that wires a `DatabaseLoader` reaches any of them. "Nine types" = the unbundled members of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`.

| # | Reader or writer | Case | FROM | TO | Arm | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `MetadataManager.get(type, name)` and `getDiagnosed`, no package, after the boot pass | two packages' rows of the name (bound by the column only, or stamped too); an action each package binds to its own object | the body of the row saved last | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `ambiguous-in-environment` naming both, as without the pass | **narrowing** | `database-loader.test.ts` `[#32521]` "two holders — after the pass a bare read is refused…" (9 types × 2 row shapes), "action, each package binding the name to its own object…" |
| 2 | `MetadataManager.get(type, name, P)` after the pass | P holds a row; another package's row was saved last | P's row read through the loaders, unstamped | P's body from its registered slot, stamped `_packageId: P` | correction | the same; `[#32458]` "the boot pass registers…" |
| 3 | `MetadataManager.list(type)` after the pass | two holders, rows bound by the column only | the row saved last alone | every package's item | widening (keeps every holder) | `[#32521]` "two holders…" |
| 4 | the boot pass's registry write | two holders | the slot of the row saved last | each package's slot | correction | `[#32521]` "two holders…" |
| 5 | `DatabaseLoader.loadMany(type)`, `loadManyKeyed(type)` | a name two packages' rows hold | one row per name, the row saved last | one row per `(package, name)` (`pluralEntryKeys`), each package's row saved last; keyed entries carry the row's package; a legacy row of a slot is not a holder; one package's action bound to two objects is still one row | widening (library) | `[#32521]` "the loaders-only plural reads keep one item per (package, name)…"; `[#32246]` "keeps a row per package…"; `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` "with history not tracked…", "the loaders' by-name reads still answer the item saved last; the plural reads answer every package's item…" |
| 6 | `MetadataManager.loadMany(type)`, `loadManyKeyed(type)` over a `DatabaseLoader` | a name two packages' rows hold | the one row the loader handed on | both holders, one item per `(package, name)` (#32517's keying, now fed both rows) | widening (library) | `[#32521]` "the loaders-only plural reads…" |
| 6a | `MetadataManager.loadMany(type)`'s stamp | a name a loader's keyed read holds for two packages, rows bound by the column only | unstamped | each body stamped with its own row's package, paired by content, only where that loader's bodies of the name are exactly its rows keyed by it | widening (library) | `[#32458]` "two holders — loadMany stamps the row's package…"; `[#32521]` "two holders… bound by the column only" |
| 6b | the same, beside another row's body that says the name (#32458's F3 shape) | a row keyed otherwise whose body carries the name | one unstamped body | no body of the name stamped | unchanged arm | `[#32521]` "agent, two holders of a name and another row's body that says the same name…" |
| 7 | the boot pass, two holders and a package-less row of the name | the package-less row saved first, between, or last; host declaring no package, either holder's, or another | the row saved last alone in the registry (when that is the package-less one, in the host's slot on a host that declares a package) | each package's slot and the package-less item in the name's bare slot, on every host, all as without the pass | correction (bare read: row 1; non-holder read: row 7a) | `[#32521]` "two holders and a package-less row saved…" (9 types × 3 orders × 4 hosts) |
| 7a | `MetadataManager.get(type, name, P)` after the pass, P holding no row of the name | two holders and a package-less row saved last | the package-less body | nothing (`undefined`), as without the pass | **narrowing** | the same |
| 8 | runtime bare `/actions/:object/:action` and MCP `run_action` with no protocol merged listing (`collectActionDeclarations` over `metadata.loadMany('action')`) | two packages' declarations of a name | one declaration reached the door; the call ran | `pickActionHolder`'s refusal naming both, `409`; nothing runs | **narrowing** | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` `[#32521]` "two packages' rows of the name: the bare call is refused on REST and MCP, 409 naming both…" |
| 9 | objectql authored-action rebind (`resyncAuthoredActionsNow`, keys `object:name` with no package) | two packages' declarations of a name | its own read of every authored row decides; without it, the row saved last | unchanged while its own read answers; without it, the last in `loadMany`'s order | unchanged / semantic | not pinned (epic ruling record 6729825528) |
| 10 | objectql action audit (`collectEngineActionDeclarations` over `loadManyKeyed('action')`) | two packages' declarations of a name | one declaration | each package's | widening (audit log only) | input: row 6 |
